description: Listen to any assistant message while you keep working, with speech that starts playing before the whole message is synthesized. A speaker button on every message row starts playback, and the player adds pause, stop, ten-second skips in both directions, and speeds from 0.75x to 2x that persist between sessions. Playback stops on its own when you switch threads or send a new prompt, and stopping cancels the synthesis stream instead of leaving it to finish unheard. Code blocks, link targets, and bare URLs are flattened out of the text first, so a voice reads prose instead of syntax. Speech uses Microsoft Edge's public neural voices over the network, so it needs an internet connection, but no account, API key, or paid service.
